in_sanskrit.name: अर्यिन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Aryin is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'arya', which means noble, virtuous, or honorable. The name can be interpreted as 'Noble One' or 'Honorable One'.

in_hindi.name: अर्यिन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name Aryin is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'arya'. In Hindi, the word 'ary' translates to 'noble' or 'honorable'. Therefore, the name Aryin can be interpreted as 'Noble One' or 'Honorable One' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: அர்யின்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Aryin is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'arya'. In Tamil, the word 'அர்யம்' translates to 'noble' or 'honorable', and 'ஒன்பதின்' means 'one'. Therefore, the name Aryin can be interpreted as 'Noble One' or 'Honorable One' in Tamil as well.

in_telugu.name: అర్యిన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Aryin is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'arya'. In Telugu, the word 'అర్య' translates to 'noble' or 'honorable'. Therefore, the name Aryin can be interpreted as 'Noble One' or 'Honorable One' in Telugu as well.

in_marathi.name: Aryin
